[SWS_DM_01360] Consecutive registration of notifier with ClientAuthen- tication::SetNotifier()
⌈
In case of a consecutive call of ara::diag::ClientAu-
thentication::SetNotifier of the corresponding ara::diag::ClientAu-
thentication instance, DM module shall overwrite the previous registered notifier.
